objective: Independent, complete usable Go IDE reproducing GoLand 2026.1.4 as closely as practical; not a rebranded installed GoLand or a UI-only demo.
coverage: Selected feature obligations from product scope and selected shipped declarations; not exhaustive product equivalence.
status_policy: Every row starts unverified for both actual reference behavior and reconstruction. Static declarations are candidate evidence only. Passing narrow tests cannot satisfy broader rows.
